Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: AetherPress
Description: Detects completed Penumbra mod installations and offers configurable Base, Normal, and Mask texture compression. Use /aetherpress to open settings.
Punchline: Automatically compress textures in newly installed Penumbra mods.
Changelog: Skips textures with incomplete or nonstandard mip payloads before conversion, preventing those files from failing the entire mod.
